workshop.modIdHint: (Hover over the ⓘ icon to read important notes before publishing)
workshop.modIdTooltip:
The Mod ID (mod_key) is globally unique across the workshop and cannot be changed via editing after publishing; please confirm it carefully before publishing.

Original authors: use the unique original name you assigned to your mod (e.g. Freer OrderMe), ideally matching the mod's internal name, so users can find it.

Ported mods: you must use the original author's original name. Translated names or abbreviations are not allowed.
For example, a mission may be commonly abbreviated as "Mei" in the Chinese community, but searching for the original author's updates on F95zone and similar release sites will not match "Mei" — only the author's original name works.
Ports published with a translated name as the Mod ID may be deleted.
